hazard: Absence of clear responsibility for calling ambulance

concerns.quote: It was clear from the evidence that there was a 12 minute delay in the police contacting the ambulance - the police were notified of the incident but did not contact North West Ambulance Service immediately.

I was told that the 12 minute delay was due to a breakdown in communication between Greater Manchester Police control room and the Motorway Control - Greater Manchester Police thought that the Motorway Control were contacting the ambulance and vice versa.
concerns.hazard: breakdown in communication between police control room and Motorway Control

concerns.quote: It seems to me that procedure should be in place whereby it is immediately established who is going to be responsible for calling the ambulance to avoid any delays, and the ambulance is called for at once.
concerns.hazard: absence of clear responsibility for calling ambulance

reports.title: Samuel Curless: Prevention of future deaths report

promises.quote: the Force Contact, Crime and Operations Branch will further reinforce the requirements on call handlers to call an ambulance when faced with a scenario such as that which presented in the case of Mr Curless. This will be achieved by way of an email being sent to all call handlers and by including an item on each call handling team's briefing site.
promises.summary: Reinforce call handlers' duty to call ambulance for hanging deaths via email and briefing site updates.

concerns.hazard: calling ambulance to scene when someone is reported dead

concerns.quote: the training delivered to the first two attending officers did not adequately prepare them for responding to a scene where someone is found hanging in a way which is consistent with their priority to preserve life of a hanging casualty.
concerns.hazard: inadequate training for hanging scene response

concerns.quote: I am concerned that both officers' training on Sudden Death (and the training of others) was delivered as one of over 15 online modules on a given day and that at the time of the inquest, they had not received any classroom based or on the job training.

there is an unknown number of GMP officers who are not meeting the expectation of receiving First Aid refresher training within 12 months, which since May 2022 has included training on how to resuscitate a hanging casualty.
concerns.hazard: lack of first aid refresher training for hanging casualties

links.explanation: Both reports concern failures in ensuring that an ambulance is summoned promptly by police personnel. The earlier report highlights unclear responsibility for making the call, while the later report points to insufficient training and learning about the duty to call an ambulance even when a person is reported dead.
